title: Venezuela's deposed Maduro pleads not guilty, insists still president
summary: A defiant Venezuelan president Nicolas Maduro pleaded not guilty to drug trafficking and other charges in a New York court on Monday, two days after being snatched by US forces in a stunning raid on his home in Caracas. Maduro, 63, told a federal judge in Manhattan "I'm innocent. I'm not guilty." FRANCE 24's Jessica Le Masurier reports from New York.
